title: Just Vulkan
description: Improving performance by yeeting OpenGL to use Vulkan instead!
body:
## IMPORTANT!

```
Some older devices which do not support Vulkan will not be able to use this modpack. Please check if your device, specifically your iGPU/GPU, supports it! 
```
## COMPATIBILITY
Refer to the following link to see if your device supports the API: [Vulkan Compatible Hardware Databse](https://vulkan.gpuinfo.org/)

This beta modpack is an attempt to use the newer graphics API, Vulkan, as opposed to OpenGL, with the goal of optimizing the game. Vulkan API is a newer alternative to OpenGL, with better performance. However, as a tradeoff, many mods are incompatible with the API as much of their code needs to be updated.

The modpack is especially useful for low-end but somewhat new and mid-end devices that struggle to get a playable framerate.

Vulkan Mod is still in development and thus, you may encounter some bugs. Sadly I can not fix them.

## Performance

### Test 1
The following test was conducted with the following conditions:
  > **CPU**: Intel(R) Pentium(R) 5405U @2.30GHz 

  > **RAM**: 6GB (allocated RAM) 

  > **OS**: Windows 11

  > **Settings**: Provided with modpack

Average FPS: 57

I hope the pack gives you a decent boost in performance!

Has this modpack enhanced your playing experience?
If so, please recommend the pack to your friends! :D
